responsibilities_block: Sample according to plans and perform appearance, dimensional, and performance inspections.

Determine conformity according to standards and issue inspection reports.
Label, isolate, and trace batches of nonconforming products.
Report inspection anomalies and participate in cause analysis and corrective actions.
Maintain inspection equipment and standards documents and support audits and calibration.
page.work_context_block: During the day, you move between the production line and inspection room, sample according to plans, measure dimensions with calipers, test performance with instruments, record data, and determine conformity. When anomalies appear, trace batches, identify causes, and meet with production. Inspection volume doubles during shipping peaks and reports are urgent; audit periods also require systems documentation, combining responsibility with detailed work.

Monitor thickness, tension, temperature, and other parameter curves.
Take samples, measure thickness and properties, and determine whether output meets standards.
Adjust rolls, change dies, and realign tooling when specifications change.
Handle anomalies such as jams, strip breaks, and misalignment.
Inspect equipment and maintain operating and quality records.
page.work_context_block: At shift handover, first review process cards and roll condition. After installing and aligning rolls, start the line and monitor the thickness curve as the steel strip passes through. Fine-tune the roll gap and tension when measurements exceed tolerance. Take intermediate samples for thickness measurement, then stop the line to adjust rolls and change dies when specifications change. Rush in to clear jams or strip breaks, and before leaving, inspect equipment, clean rolls, complete records, and document the first-piece result.
